description: This file defines a PHP class `ResetDatabaseController` responsible for handling HTTP requests to reset the database to an initial savepoint and returning the count of restored tables. It implements the `PublicControllerInterface` and uses services for database backup and HTTP response handling.

classes.name: ResetDatabaseController
classes.description: Controller class for resetting the database to its initial state during functional testing.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to reset the database and returns the response with the count of tables restored.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request to restore database and returns the response with the result.
